business_summary: Der Future Science and Technology Holding Group Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, production, and sales home furnishing products. The company offers engineered wood flooring, solid wood flooring, custom wardrobes, custom cabinets, graphene-related preparation equipment, and application products. Der Future Science and Technology Holding Group Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Der International Home Furnishing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Der Future Science and Technology Holding Group Co., Ltd. in September 2015. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Suzhou, China. Der Future Science and Technology Holding Group Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Der Group Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Der Future Science and Technology Holding Group Co., Ltd.는 홈 퍼니싱 제품의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 엔지니어링 목재 바닥재, 원목 바닥재, 맞춤형 옷장, 맞춤형 캐비닛, 그래핀 관련 준비 장비 및 응용 제품을 제공합니다. Der Future Science and Technology Holding Group Co., Ltd.는 이전에 Der International Home Furnishing Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2015년 9월에 Der Future Science and Technology Holding Group Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 2004년에 설립되었으며 중국 쑤저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다. 데르미래과학기술지주그룹(주)는 데르그룹(주)의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
